meta.title: Financial Planner

transactions.selectAllAria: Select all rows on this page

analysis.categoriesDescription: Claude reviews how your bookings are categorised and proposes changes. Accept or reject each one; accepted suggestions count as a manual assignment.
analysis.noSuggestions: No open suggestions. Either everything fits, or you have already worked through them.
analysis.appliedNote: {name}: {applied} applied, {skipped} left unchanged (categorised differently in the meantime).
analysis.openCount: {count, plural, one {# open suggestion} other {# open suggestions}}.
analysis.freeDescription: Ask Claude a question about your finances, for example: “Where could I save the most?” or “How are my fuel costs developing?”
analysis.runningSince: Running for {elapsed}. You can switch tabs, the analysis keeps going in the background.

csvUpload.imported: {added} new bookings imported, {skipped} duplicates skipped. {total} in total from {from} to {to}. Balance: {balance}.
csvUpload.invalidRows: {count} rows with an invalid date or amount were skipped.
csvUpload.checkNotStarted: The review could not be started.
csvUpload.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read.
csvUpload.checking: Claude is reviewing the new bookings. Nothing is imported until you approve.
csvUpload.balanceDescription: The file holds {rows} bookings from {from} to {to}. It says how the balance changed, not where it stands. For that you need one reference point.
csvUpload.balanceHint: The balance after the last booking in the file. For an export up to today, that is the figure your banking app is showing right now.
csvUpload.reviewSummary: {newCount, plural, one {# new booking} other {# new bookings}} from {from} to {to}, {duplicates} already present. Nothing has been imported yet.
csvUpload.claudeFailedNote: Claude check failed: {error} Category suggestions are missing. The recurring matches below do not depend on Claude.
csvUpload.claudeSignInHint: After signing in, cancel this upload and upload the file again so the check runs.
csvUpload.claudeOffNote: Claude is switched off, so nothing was sent. The matches below come from the app alone.
csvUpload.claudeSkippedNote: Continued without the Claude check, so there are no category suggestions. The matches below come from the app alone.
csvUpload.expectedTitle: Expected, but not in the file
csvUpload.expectedDescription: Recurring items due within the file's span for which no booking was recognized. Assign a booking or skip the date.
csvUpload.expectedNone: Every recurring item due within the span was recognized.
csvUpload.expectedNoneDue: No recurring item was due within the file's span.
csvUpload.showPlain: {count, plural, one {Show # more booking without a match} other {Show # more bookings without a match}}
csvUpload.noFlaggedRows: No booking with a match or a suggestion.
csvUpload.footerCounts: {bookings} bookings · {recurring} recurring matched · {oneOffs} one-off · {categories} categories · {missing} expected, not found
csvUpload.doneNothingNew: No new bookings: all {count} are already present.
csvUpload.doneReview: {recurring, plural, one {# recurring item} other {# recurring items}} matched, {oneOffs} one-off items removed as booked, {categories} categories applied, {skipped} dates skipped.
csvUpload.doneMissingHint: These dates stay marked as open in the Recurring tab.

dashboard.chartWithHistory: Actual history since {from} and a forecast over {months} months.
dashboard.chartHint: Every item is booked on the day it is actually due. Hover the curve to see the payments falling due.
dashboard.trendHint: The dotted line shows your real monthly average of {amount} for comparison.
dashboard.trendTooShort: There is not enough imported history for a monthly average yet (less than four weeks).
dashboard.staleBody: The newest imported booking is from {date}, {days} days ago. Everything after it is forecast, including days that have already passed.
dashboard.budgetsDescription: Monthly limits per category for {period}. Bookings count towards their category; the forecast books the budget amount each period. The bar fills with what is spent, the striped part shows where the current pace lands at the end of the period, and anything past the budget line is over. Hover a bar for details.
dashboard.spendingDescription: From the imported bookings. A keyword search shows how the matches split by counterparty.
dashboard.addRecurringDescription: Repeating amounts: monthly, quarterly, every six months or yearly.
dashboard.recurringNoneOpen: Every recurring item due so far is booked or skipped.
dashboard.addOneOffDescription: Irregular amounts on a given date. Planned income shows up in the forecast too.
dashboard.transactionsEmpty: No bookings yet. Upload a bank CSV export.
dashboard.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
dashboard.traceDescription: Every booking in the forecast from {anchor} (opening balance {balance}) to the first negative balance on {broke}.
dashboard.traceExcluded: {count} excluded one-off items are deliberately missing here.
dashboard.traceFootnote: Budgets book at the end of the month; payments dated before the last import land on the following day.
dashboard.settingsDescription: Set the opening balance and the forecast horizon.
dashboard.budgetStartDayHint: If your salary arrives on the 15th, a value of “15” runs budgets from the 15th to the 14th of the next month instead of over the calendar month.
dashboard.noImportedData: No imported account data. Duplicate bookings are skipped automatically on import.
dashboard.startDateHint: Only relevant without imported bookings: the forecast starts from this day. With bookings, the last import counts.
dashboard.oneOffPanelNote: Hidden items do not feed into the forecast or the ending balance. Switch off items that are already booked so they do not count twice.

claudeLogin.title: Claude sign-in
claudeLogin.description: The import review and this analysis use the Claude Code CLI on the server. It has to be signed in to your Anthropic account.
claudeLogin.pasteHint: Sign in there, copy the code it shows and paste it here.

claudePrivacy.title: Claude
claudePrivacy.description: Claude reviews new bookings during an import and answers questions under Ask Claude. While it is on, booking texts and amounts are sent to Anthropic.
claudePrivacy.offHint: Off: nothing leaves this computer. Imports work without category suggestions.
claudePrivacy.onHint: On: booking texts and amounts are sent to Anthropic, with the details below hidden first.
claudePrivacy.namesHint: Your own name, family, your landlord. Found in any order and case, also as single first or last names.
claudePrivacy.askOffBody: Turn it on in Settings to get category suggestions and ask questions about your finances.
claudePrivacy.previewHint: Shows the exact text a run would send, built from your current data with the masking applied. Nothing is sent.
claudePrivacy.previewDescription: Built on this computer from your current data, with the masking applied. Nothing is sent from here.
claudePrivacy.previewOffNote: Claude is off, so none of this is sent yet.
claudePrivacy.previewQuestionPlaceholder: Where could I save money each month?
claudePrivacy.previewImportNote: Example: your {count, plural, one {most recent booking} other {# most recent bookings}}, as if just imported.
claudePrivacy.previewNothingHidden: No personal details found to hide.
claudePrivacy.hiddenEMAIL: {count, plural, one {# email address} other {# email addresses}}
claudePrivacy.hiddenCREDITOR: {count, plural, one {# creditor ID} other {# creditor IDs}}
claudePrivacy.hiddenCARD: {count, plural, one {# card number} other {# card numbers}}
claudePrivacy.hiddenPHONE: {count, plural, one {# phone number} other {# phone numbers}}
claudePrivacy.alwaysHiddenIntro: Replaced with placeholders such as [IBAN-1] before anything is sent:
claudePrivacy.alwaysReferences: Customer, contract, invoice and tax numbers, SEPA references
claudePrivacy.alwaysCodes: Any other code with five or more digits
claudePrivacy.neverSent: The IBAN and BIC columns of your bank file are never sent. Dates, amounts and counterparty names are sent as they are, unless you list a name below.
claudePrivacy.namesSaveFailed: The list could not be saved. Please try again.
